title: feat(formula): label(record.<field>) renders a select value in the reader's locale
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB77M1hT4XaiEVd31sLrD2dU)_ Fixes #26608 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: added Skills-docs: #26760 ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：新增 CEL 函数 `label(record.)`，把 select 字段的存储值渲染为读者语言的选项标签；objectql 在读和写的响应里按请求的 `Accept-Language` 给公式备好标签。`'v' + string(record.version_no) + ' · ' + label(record.kind)` 对 zh-CN 读者是 `v2 · 清稿`，对 en-US 读者是 `v2 · Clean`。 - **为什么改**：select 存的是值，公式 nameField 只能拼出 `v2 · clean`，保存提示和记录标题对所有语言的读者都显示英文值（#26608）。 - **风险与回滚**：只有调用 `label(` 的公式才会构建标签表，其余读路径只多一次源码扫描。没有新的翻译键，也没有第二条翻译路径（复用 `translateObject`，与 `GET /meta/object` 同一函数）。i18n 服务缺失或抛错时退回声明的标签，读不会失败。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/formula-option-labels.ts`，然后 `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts` 里的 `bindOptionLabel`。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-formula-option-label.test.ts`，以及 `packages/qa/dogfood` 下的 `test/formula-option-label-locale.dogfood.test.ts`。 - **需要你做的**：本 PR 改了 `skills/**`（Tier H），落地需要你的同意。 ## What changes **`@objectstack/formula`** - `label(record.)` joins the CEL stdlib and `CEL_STDLIB_FUNCTIONS`. It is a macro: the type check accepts exactly `record.` and refuses a literal, a path through a lookup, an optional select, `previous.` and any computed argument, with a message that names the one shape. - It reads data only. `EvalContext.optionLabels` (new, type `EvalOptionLabels`: field → stored value → label) is resolved by the caller in the reader's locale before evaluation, so the stdlib holds no translator or resolver. It is not mounted as a CEL variable. - An empty value reads `''`, and a value no option declares reads as itself, as the select control shows it. A field with no options (on every row, empty or not), a list value (multi-select), and a context with no `optionLabels` fail loudly. - The measured catalog counts in `validate.ts` are updated (77 registered names, 42 callable bare, 30 from `registerStdLib`, 38 advertised). The receiver-only count also picks up `hasCapability`, which was already registered on main and missing from the prose. **`@objectstack/objectql`** - New `formula-option-labels.ts` builds the map for one read: the object's fields that declare `options`, with the i18n service's bundle laid over them by `translateObject` from `@objectstack/spec/system`. The bundle and the locale options (`fallbackChain`, `defaultLocale`) are built as the REST metadata route builds them, so the label a formula prints is the label the select control shows the same reader: `objects..fields..options.`, then `picklists.

.options.`, then the declared label. No key is spelled in this module. - `applyFormulaPlan` passes the map to `ExpressionEngine.evaluate`. The map is built only when some formula in the plan calls `label(`. - Wired readers, each in `ExecutionContext.locale` (the request's `Accept-Language`): `find`, `findOne`, the insert and update responses (`hydrateWriteFormulas`), and `serveFormulaField`. `expandRelatedRecords` already runs a `find` with the read's context, so expanded lookups follow. - Declared labels: stored expressions (`computeStoredExpressions`), the synchronous `evaluateFormulaField`, any read with no locale, and an engine with no i18n service or one whose `getTranslations` throws. - `setI18nService` accepts the optional `getTranslations`, `getFallbackLocale` and `getDefaultLocale` it now reads. `II18nService` already carries all three. **Docs and skill** - `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` gains an "Options" row for `label(record.f)` (+116 tokens, 5627 of 5997). The row says it answers only in formula fields and faults in a predicate. - `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` gains the stdlib row and a cookbook entry, "Record name from an option label". **Skills readings** | Measure | Before | After | |:---|---:|---:| | `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` lines | 465 | 471 | | `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` tokens (ceiling 5997) | 5511 | 5627 | | Bundle, all `SKILL.md`, lines | 4600 | 4606 | | Bundle, all `SKILL.md`, tokens (`ceil(bytes / 4)`) | 56017 | 56133 | | `evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` tokens (ceiling 1046) | 1046 | 1046 | ## Readers (measured) | Reader | Where it gets the name | Locale | |:---|:---|:---| | Save toast (`recordSaveMessage`, app-shell) | the POST/PATCH response | writer's `Accept-Language` | | Record page H1 (`getRecordDisplayName`) | `GET /data/:object/:id` → `findOne` | reader's | | Related list | list read → `find` | reader's | | Lookup display | `expand` → `find` with the same context | reader's | | REST GET / POST / PATCH | the same engine paths | request's | | Search | does not index formula fields (`SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES`) | unchanged | | Stored computed field (`text` + `expression`) | computed once on write | declared labels | | `evaluateFormulaField` (sync, e.g. a hook's record-title accessor) | evaluated with no read context | declared labels (left out) | No `ui/**` file changes: the console renders the name the server serves. The console sends its display language as `Accept-Language` on every call. ## Tests - `packages/formula/src/option-label.test.ts` (new): zh-CN and en-US maps, per-field maps, empty and undeclared values, the run-time faults, the compile-time refusals, and `inferExpressionType` returning `text`. - `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.test.ts`: `label` joins the drift probe. - `packages/objectql/src/engine-formula-option-label.test.ts` (new): the insert response in zh-CN and en-US, the update response, `findOne` and `find` per locale, a base-language tag (`zh`), no locale, a stored expression keeping the declared label under a zh-CN writer, and no i18n service or a throwing one. - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/formula-option-label-locale.dogfood.test.ts` (new, real boot): POST in zh-CN and en-US, GET by id in both, PATCH in zh-CN, the list read in zh-CN, and the name matching the option label `GET /meta/object/:name` serves in the same locale. ## Acceptance notes - `label()` in a validation rule, predicate or flow condition has no option labels and faults loudly instead of comparing against a label; the docs say to compare the stored value there. No publish-time refusal of `label()` outside a formula is built in this PR. - The skill eval is owed, as #26760: `cel-predicates-formulas.json` is at its ceiling (1046 of 1046), and a compact case measures about 130 tokens. - Search indexing is unchanged. ## Verification All runs on `f780ce78`, in a cloud worktree, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, unless a section names `8ffe3ae6`.

Unit tests: @objectstack/formula and @objectstack/objectql - `@objectstack/formula`: `option-label.test.ts`, `cel-engine.test.ts` and `skill-catalog-sync.test.ts` pass (94 tests), and `cel-stdlib-drift.test.ts` passes. The catalog counts in `validate.ts` were measured on the built environment (77 / 42 / 35 / 30 / 38). - `@objectstack/objectql`: `engine-formula-option-label.test.ts` passes 7/7; with the other `engine-formula*` files, 8 files and 135 tests pass.
Dogfood on a real boot - `@objectstack/dogfood`: `formula-option-label-locale.dogfood.test.ts` passes 5/5.
Typecheck - `typecheck` passes for `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/objectql` (including `check:test-typecheck`). - `tsc --noEmit` passes for `@objectstack/dogfood` with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`; at the default heap it runs out of memory locally, before reporting anything.
Derived gates: 102 commands, 101 measured green, 1 not measured - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 102 commands; 99 exit 0 on the first run. - `check:objectql-double-limit` found that the new test's `find` double ignored the caller's `limit`. Fixed in `f780ce78`, and it now reports OK. - `spec check:skill-examples` exited 3 because the client SDK was not built. After building `@objectstack/client-react` and its dependencies it passes: 266 examples type-check. - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 because it needs a whole-repo build; nothing was measured. That is left to CI. - `--ran` with exit codes: 102 derived families accounted for, 101 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (the recorded exit 3).
Contract-review should-fixes on 8ffe3ae6 - `optionLabelOf` checks the field's options before the empty-value answer; `option-label.test.ts` pins a null text field faulting. - `@objectstack/formula`: `option-label`, `cel-engine`, `skill-catalog-sync` and `cel-stdlib-drift` pass (4 files, 98 tests); `typecheck` passes. `@objectstack/objectql`: `engine-formula-option-label.test.ts` passes 7/7 against the rebuilt formula package. - Exit 0: `spec check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `spec check:skill-examples`.
Skills token ratchet - `check-skills-token-ratchet` exits 0. The readings are in the Skills readings table above.
